description: This file defines the TextNode class in the Twig templating engine. It represents a text node within a template's node tree and provides methods for compilation into PHP code.

classes.name: Twig\Node\TextNode
classes.description: Represents a text node in the Twig template engine's syntax tree, capable of compiling itself into executable PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TextNode instance with the given text data and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the TextNode into PHP code using the provided Compiler object, generating code that yields the data string.
